decisions.reason: Product A has substantial investment in a multi-model line and a dedicated website page, creating visible commitment that escalation of commitment makes hard to abandon while results may still be attributed to temporary causes.
Product B has a dedicated page and fits the firm's core thermoforming/material portfolio, indicating high sunk costs and public commitment, so management is likely to persist.
Product C is only mentioned on the website, suggesting limited investment and weak public commitment, and after four years disappointing results can no longer be attributed to temporary causes.

Although custom hearing protection earmolds have less prominent online presence, the multi-model product line and the firm's hearing-care channel ties suggest substantial investment and customer commitment, reducing the probability of dropping.
